stress.title: Stress and chronic stress
stress.aim: A calm, able state the client can start in seconds when stress begins.

steps.title: Check in
steps.say: How are you right now, from 0 (calm) to 10 (the most distress)? And how able do you feel to act, from 0 to 10?
steps.do: Agree what today's session is for. Confirm consent for every node and cue you will use.

steps.title: Paced breathing
steps.say: Breathe with the light: in for four, out for six. Let the exhale be longer.
steps.do: Run paced breathing in the player; rate distress after it.

steps.title: Build the node
steps.say: Picture the {node}: what you see, hear, feel, smell and taste in that state. Say the frame aloud: “{frame}”.
steps.do: Review the node with the client: senses, frame, glyph and vibration code. Rate how believable the frame is (0–10); reword it if it is below 6.

steps.title: Anchor the state
steps.say: Go fully into the state. At its peak, feel the code on your wrist: {code}.
steps.do: Run the node three times in the player (VIB-ANCHOR at the peak). Rate distress and agency after each run.

steps.title: Rehearse a trigger
steps.say: Bring to mind a moment of this: {trigger}. Only up to a 5 of 10. Then start the {node}.
steps.do: Imagined trigger at moderate intensity, then the node. Rate distress before and after. Stop and return to breathing above the session's distress ceiling.

steps.title: Future pacing
steps.say: See yourself in {contexts}, with the {node} already in you, acting as you want to.
steps.do: Run the node's futures (FP-ANCHOR, 150 ms × 8). Rate agency.

steps.title: Practice between sessions
steps.say: Between now and next time, start the {node} when this happens: {trigger}. And practise it {dose}.
steps.do: Agree the practice plan; the player records every run and the weekly automaticity check.

steps.title: Close
steps.say: Notice your feet on the floor and your breath. How are you now, 0 to 10? Did anything feel unpleasant today?
steps.do: Rate distress and agency. Record any unpleasant event. Therapist: rate severity (CGI-S), improvement (CGI-I) and engagement.

trauma_observer.title: A memory, observed (therapist-led)
trauma_observer.aim: A distressing memory observed from another position, where nothing binds, without reliving it.

steps.title: Check in
steps.say: How are you right now, from 0 (calm) to 10 (the most distress)? And how able do you feel to act, from 0 to 10?
steps.do: Agree what today's session is for. Confirm consent for every node and cue you will use.

steps.title: Screening
steps.say: Right now, are you in crisis, or having thoughts of harming yourself or not wanting to live?
steps.do: If the answer is yes, stop the session work and follow your crisis procedure.

steps.title: Paced breathing
steps.say: Breathe with the light: in for four, out for six. Let the exhale be longer.
steps.do: Run paced breathing in the player; rate distress after it.

steps.title: Build the node
steps.say: Picture the {node}: what you see, hear, feel, smell and taste in that state. Say the frame aloud: “{frame}”.
steps.do: Review the node with the client: senses, frame, glyph and vibration code. Rate how believable the frame is (0–10); reword it if it is below 6.

steps.say: Go fully into the state. At its peak, feel the code on your wrist: {code}.
steps.do: Run the node three times in the player (VIB-ANCHOR at the peak). Rate distress and agency after each run.

steps.title: Observe the memory
steps.say: From the observer position, let the memory play far away, small and still. Nothing binds; it is only observed.
steps.do: Therapist-led. Rate distress during. At 8 or more: stop, return to breathing and grounding; do not continue the memory today.

steps.title: Return to the able state
steps.say: Come back fully into the room and into the {node}.
steps.do: Run the client's associated node once.

steps.title: Practice between sessions
steps.say: Between now and next time, start the {node} when this happens: {trigger}. And practise it {dose}.
steps.do: Agree the practice plan; the player records every run and the weekly automaticity check.
